posts.headline: Thirteen editions and counting — Thicks is 3-0 but still hasn't earned the respect that comes with that ring.
posts.detail: Klint's Clipboard sits unbeaten at 403.68 points, yet a career 14-14 record and an average finish of 5.5 is exactly why this column keeps the champagne on ice — a title means you get doubted harder, not less.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's gaudy 20-8 résumé is now officially a crime scene at 0-3.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra owns a 1.5 average finish across two seasons, the best pedigree in the league on paper, and yet here they are at 348.40 points with nothing but an L column to show for it — thirteen straight editions of this and the crater just keeps getting deeper.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are still the best team nobody wants to talk about.
posts.detail: Triciagloston is 3-0 with a league-best 499.94 points, dwarfing every other roster in this league, and after ten straight editions of me screaming about it, this league still hasn't caught on.

posts.headline: The Ultimate Light Skin's plague hits a ninth straight edition and 0-3 feels biblical now.
posts.detail: BIBLE OR THE BELT is winless with 329.04 points, a far cry from redemption, and Eli's career 13-14-1 mark says this isn't a slump — it's scripture written in advance.

posts.headline: Sasinci claws to 2-1 but the Milk Man jokes aren't going anywhere.
posts.detail: Big Head's title banner is still gathering dust behind a 13-15 career record and 5.5 average finish, and 387.28 points through three weeks isn't enough receipts to quiet Saso's doubters yet.
